chunks.text: Hello everyone, welcome to my channel.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: In this video I am discussing about what is machine learning and why it matters, types

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: So without a further ado, let's get this started.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: So what is machine learning?

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Machine learning often called as ML is a branch of an artificial intelligence that enables

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: a system to learn autonomously from data and make decisions without being explicitly programmed

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The performance of ML model can be improved by providing large datasets and let the model

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: figure out the patterns.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Let's imagine how we teach a child to recognize a dog.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: We don't tell them proper rules to recognize a dog.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: But we show them many dogs and say this is a dog.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Therefore over time they learn how a dog looks like.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: So machine learning works the same way.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: We train the machine by showing it with lots of examples and it learns how to make decisions

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: based on that.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Traditional Programming vs Machine Learning

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Now let's compare machine learning with traditional programming.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: In traditional programming we write a set of predefined instructions and the computer

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: follows those instructions in order to perform the task.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Whereas in machine learning we give set of examples that is huge amount of data plus

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: our expected outputs and in machine learning the computer learns the rule automatically

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: and figure out how to accomplish the task.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Therefore machine learning is very versatile and powerful as it learns from the data and

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: improve its performance continuously.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: So why machine learning matters?

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: As we know there are lots of data these days and machine learning can handle this large

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: set of data, analyze it and find a proper value as an output.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Machine learning is also leading to the exciting innovations.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: It is the heart of many technologies we use today such as drones, VRs, robots and many more.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: It can contribute to business, finance, by fraud detection, detecting security threats,

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: disease diagnosis and so on.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Therefore machine learning is at the heart of many technologies we use today.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: It helps machine to read like spam detection and machines to see such as object detection,

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: face recognition.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Similarly it helps machine to decide on fraud detection, choosing recommendations and it

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: also helps to hear by choosing voice assistants such as Alexa or Siri.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: It helps machine to create by generating images, text, videos and so many things.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Therefore machine learning is very important as it is transforming various industries in

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: near future.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Now let's understand the basic flow of machine learning process.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The step 1 is problem statement.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: In order to decide which category of machine learning models we use, at first we should

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: have a deep understanding of our problems.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The next step is data collection where we collect all the data like emails, numbers,

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: photos and so on that is required for our models.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: And the next step is data processing.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: This step is very important part in machine learning.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: It is like clearing the data by correcting errors, scaling and removing duplicates and

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: so on.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The fourth step is to choose the right model.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: We should choose proper machine learning model for our clean data.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Step 5 is to train the model.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Once we decide machine learning model, the next step is to train the model.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Training process is feeding the data to a learning algorithm.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Once we train the model, the next step is to test the model and see how well it predicts

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: new and unseen data.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The next step is to tune and optimize the model by using more data or better methods.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The last step is deployment where machine learning model is tested in production environment.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Types of Machine Learning

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Machine learning is divided into supervised learning, unsupervised learning and reinforcement

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: learning.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Supervised learning

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Supervised learning models learn from the labeled data that means we provide input plus

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: correct output.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The goal here is to predict future output.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Examples are object detection, spam detection, forecasting and so on.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Next we have is supervised learning algorithms.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: There are different algorithms in supervised learning like linear regression, logistic

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: regression, decision trees, support vector machines or SVM, k-nearest neighbors, KNN,

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: random forest, Naive-Weir algorithm.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: So we will discuss about supervised learning in our upcoming videos.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Now let's move to the unsupervised learning.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Unsupervised learning

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Unsupervised learning models learn from unlabeled data that means we only provide lots of input

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: data and we do not give known output to the model.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The goal here is to find structure in data and provide us the proper output.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The examples are recommendation engines, anomaly detections, medical imaging and so on.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Next is unsupervised learning algorithms.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: We have hierarchical clustering, fuzzy means, k-means clustering and so on.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Reinforcement learning

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: In reinforcement learning, the model learns by doing and through various trials and errors.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: The examples are game AI like chess, robotics, self-driving cars and so on.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Now reinforcement learning is rapidly growing with huge potential and we will experience

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: more groundbreaking innovations in near future.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Applications of machine learning

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: Machine learning is almost everywhere now like in self-driving cars, security, recommendation

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: systems, customer service, voice assistance, fraud detection, digital marketing, search

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: engines and face recognition.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: So that's all for today.

chunks.title: What Is Machine Learning
chunks.text: We have learnt what is machine learning, why it is such a big deal.

text: Hello everyone, welcome to my channel. In this video I am discussing about what is machine learning and why it matters, types of machine learning and so on. So without a further ado, let's get this started. So what is machine learning? Machine learning often called as ML is a branch of an artificial intelligence that enables a system to learn autonomously from data and make decisions without being explicitly programmed The performance of ML model can be improved by providing large datasets and let the model figure out the patterns. Let's imagine how we teach a child to recognize a dog. We don't tell them proper rules to recognize a dog. But we show them many dogs and say this is a dog. Therefore over time they learn how a dog looks like. So machine learning works the same way. We train the machine by showing it with lots of examples and it learns how to make decisions based on that. Traditional Programming vs Machine Learning Now let's compare machine learning with traditional programming. In traditional programming we write a set of predefined instructions and the computer follows those instructions in order to perform the task. Whereas in machine learning we give set of examples that is huge amount of data plus our expected outputs and in machine learning the computer learns the rule automatically and figure out how to accomplish the task. Therefore machine learning is very versatile and powerful as it learns from the data and improve its performance continuously. So why machine learning matters? As we know there are lots of data these days and machine learning can handle this large set of data, analyze it and find a proper value as an output. Machine learning is also leading to the exciting innovations. It is the heart of many technologies we use today such as drones, VRs, robots and many more. It can contribute to business, finance, by fraud detection, detecting security threats, disease diagnosis and so on. Therefore machine learning is at the heart of many technologies we use today. It helps machine to read like spam detection and machines to see such as object detection, face recognition. Similarly it helps machine to decide on fraud detection, choosing recommendations and it also helps to hear by choosing voice assistants such as Alexa or Siri. It helps machine to create by generating images, text, videos and so many things. Therefore machine learning is very important as it is transforming various industries in near future. Now let's understand the basic flow of machine learning process. The step 1 is problem statement. In order to decide which category of machine learning models we use, at first we should have a deep understanding of our problems. The next step is data collection where we collect all the data like emails, numbers, photos and so on that is required for our models. And the next step is data processing. This step is very important part in machine learning. It is like clearing the data by correcting errors, scaling and removing duplicates and so on. The fourth step is to choose the right model. We should choose proper machine learning model for our clean data. Step 5 is to train the model. Once we decide machine learning model, the next step is to train the model. Training process is feeding the data to a learning algorithm. Once we train the model, the next step is to test the model and see how well it predicts new and unseen data. The next step is to tune and optimize the model by using more data or better methods. The last step is deployment where machine learning model is tested in production environment. Types of Machine Learning Machine learning is divided into supervised learning, unsupervised learning and reinforcement learning. Supervised learning Supervised learning models learn from the labeled data that means we provide input plus correct output. The goal here is to predict future output. Examples are object detection, spam detection, forecasting and so on. Next we have is supervised learning algorithms. There are different algorithms in supervised learning like linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, support vector machines or SVM, k-nearest neighbors, KNN, random forest, Naive-Weir algorithm. So we will discuss about supervised learning in our upcoming videos. Now let's move to the unsupervised learning. Unsupervised learning Unsupervised learning models learn from unlabeled data that means we only provide lots of input data and we do not give known output to the model. The goal here is to find structure in data and provide us the proper output. The examples are recommendation engines, anomaly detections, medical imaging and so on. Next is unsupervised learning algorithms. We have hierarchical clustering, fuzzy means, k-means clustering and so on. Reinforcement learning In reinforcement learning, the model learns by doing and through various trials and errors. The examples are game AI like chess, robotics, self-driving cars and so on. Now reinforcement learning is rapidly growing with huge potential and we will experience more groundbreaking innovations in near future. Applications of machine learning Machine learning is almost everywhere now like in self-driving cars, security, recommendation systems, customer service, voice assistance, fraud detection, digital marketing, search engines and face recognition.
